messages:
Maya (partnerships): Heads up — setting up a Partner Zone sync with NVIDIA / AMD / Habana to align launch phasing, marketplace listing cadence, and SI rollouts. Need to nail embargo windows and lab gating. Who can join later today?
James (platform): I can join. Need to include capacity constraints and rollback plan (esp for H200).
Liam (eng-infra): I can make it but lab calendar is tight. MI300 testbeds mostly booked 3/22-3/29. We can shuffle one run if we get confirmation today.
Sofia (field-eng): SI asked for a 2-week buffer after GA for training + workshops — they stressed that's required for partner enablement.
Maya (partnerships): Noted. Quick proposal for phased rollout (high level):
```
Phase 0: internal cert + SI dry-run (1 week)
Phase 1: limited marketplace beta (select accounts/regions)
Phase 2: full marketplace + public press
```
Recommend 72h embargo after Phase 1 before public press. Thoughts?
James (platform): 72h could work but we need a canary route and auto-fallback to a lower-capacity model variant if H200 infra degrades. Also suggest pre-warming KV caches for canary traffic.
Liam (eng-infra): We'll expose a canary flag and route policy. Also request reserving 8 A100s as hot-standby for first 48h of Phase1 — cheaper than throttled H200 but mitigates outage risk.
Maya (partnerships): Good call. Also: SI handoff checklist — runbooks, credentials, sample prompts, and training calendar. Whoever owns runbooks?
Sofia (field-eng): Field-eng will own runbooks. We need PS involvement for onsite workshops if partners want GA+1-week sessions.
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window for B200 pool: 2273539200 — will block new provisioning for ~6h (automated notice).
Elena (marketing): @Maya comms preference is embargo until Phase2, but marketing is OK with a partner-only pre-announce at Phase1 if legal approves. Need final dates by EOD.
James (platform): Action items —
- Liam: confirm MI300 availability and ability to reserve 8 A100 hot-standby
- Liam: draft canary + fallback route config (include KV cache pre-warm steps)
- Maya: confirm SI buffer and embargo preference with partners
- Elena: draft partner-only pre-announce and full press copy skeleton
I'll spin up a workspace doc and link it in calendar invite.
Maya (partnerships): I'll send invites + attach the workspace. Please add constraints to the doc if you have hard blockers.
Liam (eng-infra): ack :thumbsup: — will update lab calendar and doc by EOD.
Sofia (field-eng): ack — will draft runbook outline.
Elena (marketing): ack :eyes: — will draft pre-announce and circulate for legal review.
James (platform): cheers, see you on the sync. If anyone can't make it, drop notes in the doc.
Maya (partnerships): thanks — ping me if your availability changes.
